basics.name: Tomoki Cheung
basics.label: Computer Science Student & Web Developer
basics.summary: I am pursuing a B.S. in Computer Science on the general track at the University of Hawaii at Manoa, and I expect to graduate in Fall 2027. Alongside school I run a small web development studio in Honolulu, building sites for businesses that do not have anyone technical on staff. I recently rebuilt my personal site at tomokicheung.com and kept the repository public, decision records included, so the reasoning behind it can be read alongside the code. I like building things, and I am working toward a career where software and hardware meet.
